ghosts.name: Spirit
traits: Cannot hunt for 180 seconds (3 minutes) instead of 90 after a incense is used next to it.
strategies: If the entity attack before 3 minutes after an incense was used on it, it is not a spirit.

ghosts.name: Wraith
power: Can teleport to any player
traits: Will never disturb salt pile when walking on it, even during a hunt.
Can teleport to any player at any moment, causing an EMF 2 (or 33% chance for an EMF 5).
strategies: If the entity walk on a pile of salt during a hunt and does not disturb it, it is a wraith (be sure to double check with the Gallue, that it can never step in salt).
When a player gets an interaction or an EMF 2 or 5 far from the ghost room, it is likely to be a wraith.

ghosts.name: Phantom
power: Can roam to any player
Drain sanity faster when showing
traits: Taking a photo/video of a phantom will make it diseapear, and the entity will never be visible on resulting media.
Can roam to any player at any moment, causing an EMF 2 in the room at the end of the roam (when arriving at the player).
Will show less during hunt (the invisible period of flickering will be longer).
strategies: If a photo is saying "ghost photo" but the entity is not visible on it, it is a phantom (make sure to double check because of sync bugs and camera angle bugs).
When a player gets an interaction or an EMF 2 far from the ghost room, it is likely to be a phantom.
If the entity is clearly less visible during a hunt, it is a phantom.

ghosts.name: Poltergeist
weakness: Throw more objects during a hunt
power: Can throw multiple objects at once
Can throw objects further away
traits: When multiple objects are close to eachother, it can throw the whole pile at once (or make them levitate, which will not leave traces after).
When throwing an object, it has a small chance to throw it with a greater force (can append during hunt).
During a hunt, it will throw an object every 0.5 seconds (instead of 50% chance every 0.5 seconds) if there is an object to throw near it.
strategies: Making a pile (or multiple ones in big room) of objects make the poltergeist ability easier to recognize.
Check the number of objects thrown during a hunt, and the speed at which they are being thrown.

ghosts.name: Banshee
power: Hunts depends only on target's sanity
traits: Will chose a unique target at the start of the game, and will only change when it dies or disconnect
Unable to chase/kill non-target player while the current target is inside the building.
When making a paranormal sound, it has a 33% chance to make one of its unique scream instead.
The sanity required to start a hunt is only based on it's target and not the average sanity, making it possible to start a hunt at 85% or 15% average sanity.
strategies: Check average and individual sanity after a hunt.
Listen to ghost screams with a Parabolic microphone or a sound recorder.
Check if the ghost is able to see and hunt every player.

ghosts.name: Jinn
weakness: Cannot directly turn off the fuse box
Unable to use it's ability when fuse box is off
power: Will have a greater speed if targetting player is far from it
traits: Cannot turn the fuse box off directly (but it can turn it off by turning on too many lights).
The ghost will have a greater speed (2.5 m/s) only if it is targetting a player, the player is more than 3m away and the fuse box is on.
strategies: When fuse box turn off, check the lights switches. If somes are still turned on, then the entity turn off the fuse box directly. If not, the fuse box tripped because of too many light active.
The Jinn is still able to do the "turn off the fuse box" event. So if an EMF is linked to no event near the fuse box, it might be the Jinn trying to turn it off.

ghosts.name: Mare
weakness: Can instantly turn a switch off after a player turned it on
Cannot turn on a light switch
power: More likely to turn off the lights
traits: When a player turn on a light switch and the mare is within a 4m range, it can turn off the switch instantly after.
The hunt sanity threshold depends on the room the ghost currently is (not his favorite room). If lights are on in this room, the threshold is 40%, else it is 60%.
The mare has an increased chance to turn off or shatter the lights.
strategies: During a ghost event, if a switch is turned off instantly after a player turned it on, then the ghost is a mare.
The mare prefer the dark, so if the ghost is roaming or changing is favorite frequently when the lights are on in his room, it is likely a mare.
If the ghost turn on a light, then it is not a mare.

ghosts.name: Revenant
power: Very fast when hunting a player
traits: During a hunt, when roaming the revenant will be very slow, with speed of 1 m/s compared to the standard 1.7 m/s.
Be careful, as soon as the ghost detects and track a player, it will be very fast with it's speed instantly turning to 3 m/s instead of building up.
The speed will decrease when the ghost arrive at the last location it detected the player, returning in ~ 2.5s to it's slow speed.
strategies: The ghost speed is the only way to detect if the ghost is a revenant.

ghosts.name: Shade
weakness: Less likely to interact when average sanity is high
Cannot do anything while in the same room of a player
traits: When doing an event, the ghost have a 0% chance of seccessfully performing that event. The success rate increases by 2% per percentage of average sanity lost.
When a player is in the same room as the shade, any interaction, event or hunt will be canceled.

Be careful, when a ghost does an interaction or an event, it has a range in which it can do it. A shade could then interact in the room where a player is, by interacting while being in a neighbor room.
When doing an event the shade have an increased chance of appearing as a shadow.

when appearing using cursed possessions (summoning circle, music box ...) the shade is the only ghost that has a chance of appearing as a shadow. It will still return to normal form when starting the hunt after.
strategies: Due to it's (in)abilities and very low hunt threshold, the lack of interaction may be pointing that the ghost is a shade.
If the ghost appear in a shade form when using a cursed possession, it is a shade.

ghosts.name: Demon
power: Can initiate a hunt at any moments
Can hunt more often
Less affected by incense
traits: The demon can initiate a hunt moments regardless of average sanity. If it is in a period in which it cannot hunt (hunt cooldown, setup phase ...) it will still prevent the hunt.
The hunt cooldown of a demon is 20s instead of 25.
Crucifix have ranged increased by 50% for demons.
Incense will only prevents hunt for 60s instead of 90.
strategies: If the ghost hunt while the average sanity is above 80%, it is a demon (stay careful with the banshee unique target ability and average sanity).
If the ghost hunt before 25s after another hunt, it is a demon.
If the ghost hunt before 90s after using an incense on it, it is a demon.
The crucifix range is less likely to help eliminate demon (if it hunt very close to the crucifix normal range) as it is difficult to know the exact ghost location.

ghosts.name: Yurei
weakness: Incense will trap it in his room
Can only fully close or fully open door
power: Can gently close a door, causing everyone nearby to loose a lot of sanity
traits: When using an icense on a yurei, it will teleport it in his room and trap it inside for the duration of the incense (90s).
The yurei cannot slightly open or close door. It can only fully close or fully open them. This is only true when the ghost is not hunting.
It's ability is to gently closing a door instead of slamming it, causing every player in a range of 7.5m to loose 15% of their sanity, and creating an EMF 2 interaction
strategies: Keeping a maximum number of door fully open may help to witness the yurei ability.
If a door is only partially opened or closed outside of a hunt, it is not a yurei.
Trapping the ghost with an incense and checking it's position with motion sensors can help eliminating the yurei.

ghosts.name: Oni
power: Drains more sanity when colliding with a player during an event
traits: The yurei is slightly more visible during hunts (the visible period of flickering will be longer).
Cannot perform the mist event (white fog ball comming toward a player and hissing on collision). Be carefull as some other events or hunt sound can cause the same hissing.
When colliding with a player during an event, it will drains double of the standard sanity (20%).
strategies: If the ghost does a mist event, it is not an oni.
If the ghost is slightly more visible during hunt, it is an oni (hard to differentiate from standard ghost without training).

ghosts.name: Yokai
weakness: When hunting, the yokai will only hear and sense people close to him
power: Talking when in the same room as him will increase the hunt sanity threshold
traits: When a player is using voice chat or global voice chat in the same room as the yokai, the hunt sanity threhold jump from 50% to 80%.
When hunting, the yokai will only hear voice chat from 2.5m instead of the standard 9m. It will also sense electronic devices from 2.5m instead of 7.5m.
strategies: When the ghost is hunting, you can test if it is a yokai by activating electronics or global voice chat while staying out of it sight. If the ghost is pretty close but doesn't notice, it is a yokai.

ghosts.name: Hantu
power: Fast in colder room
Cool down room around it in during hunt
traits: The hantu speed can vary from 1.4m/s in room > 15°C, to 2.7m/s in room < 0°C. It will also not build up speed when it have a line of sight with a player.
During a hunt, it will cool down room it is currently in, making it dangerous to loop it over a long period since it's speed will rapidely.
During a hunt, it will also emit freezing breath around it's head, no matter the room temperature.
strategies: In practice, the ghost will have a greater speed near and inside his favorite room, and a lower speed elsewhere, which can help identifying it safely and rapidly.
If the ghost is emitting freezing breath during a hunt, it is a Hantu.

ghosts.name: Goryo
power: D.O.T.S. is only visible through a camera
Cannot enter D.O.T.S. state while a player is in the room
traits: When roaming, instead of having a chance to perform a long or short roam, the goryo will always perform short roam (3m max).
In higher difficulty where the ghost can change room, the goryo will never change it's favorite room (unless monkey paw is used).
The goryo has a higher chance to enter the D.O.T.S. state, but if a player is in the same room, it will fail.
The D.O.T.S. form of the goryo is only visible on a camera.
strategies: If you see a D.O.T.S. on a camera, but not with naked eye, it is a goryo. Conversely, if a D.O.T.S. is seen without a camera, it is not a goryo.
Hunts almost always starting from the ghost favorite room can indicate a goryo, although it is not very reliable.
If the ghost wander far from the ghost room, it can eliminate goryo, but it also not very reliable since the path of a roam doesn't need to be fully inside the 3m range, but only the ending location.

ghosts.name: Myling
power: Quietter footstep when hunting
traits: The myling can produce a paranormal sound every 64 to 127s instead of every 80 to 127s.
When hunting, the footstep will be less audible from further away (quiet at 12m instead of 20m).
strategies: Since the electronic interference range (10m) is almost the same as the myling audible range, dropping a flashlight and checking the sound emitted by the ghost at the electronic interference range can help identifying a myling. Be sure to check speed to not confuse it with a raiju.
If a paranormal sound is recorded or heard less than 80s after the last one, it is a goryo.

ghosts.name: Onryo
weakness: Hunt sanity threshold lower near a flame
power: Every 3 flame blown out, it will attempt to hunt
Blow more flame when more players are dead
traits: When the onryo is near a flame, the hunt sanity threshold drops from 60% to 40%
If a onryo tries to hunt within 4m of a flame, the hunt will be canceled and it will blow the flame instead. This doesn't restart the hunt cooldown timer.
Since the ability to prevent hunt with candle can happend at any time, the onryo can blow out the same flame in less than 20s.
When the onryo blow a flame for the third time, it will try to hunt, regardless of the average sanity.
The base chances and frequency of blowing a flame for an onryo is the same as every other ghost. However, this frequency will increase with the number of player currently dead.
strategies: Put a candle on top of a crucifix. If the crucifix is used before the candle to prevent a hunt, this might not be an onryo (with crucifix tier 2 and 3, the range is larger than the candle prevention range, so this method is not entirely reliable).
If three candles are blown by the ghost and it then tries to hunt soon after the third one (from 1s to 6s after), it might be an onryo.
If a ghost blow out the same flame twice within a 20s interval, it is a onryo.

ghosts.name: The Twins
weakness: Can interact two times in a row
power: Can change speed between hunt
Can hunt from two differents angles
traits: Mechanically, the twins is only one single ghost, so motion sensor, salt and temperature will never produce the evidence that there is two ghosts. Additionnaly, two hunts or ghost events cannot happend at the same time.

When interacting with the environnement, the twins have a chance to use it's ability instead. It will first interact very close to where it is (up to 4m) and then perform another interaction further away (up to 17m). Both interaction have the 33% chances to trigger an EMF 5.
When hunting, and after checking if it can hunt or if it is prevented by a crucifix, the twin will choose to be either slow (1.5m/s) or fast (1.9m/s), with 50% chances for each.
If the ghost choose to be slow, it will start to hunt from where it currently is.

If the ghost choose to be fast, it will first teleport to the last far-range interaction it did with it's ability, and then beggin to hunt. Since the crucifix check is done before this, this is the only ghost than can beggin the hunt in top of a crucifix.
strategies: Having EMF 5 far from the ghost room, where no other evidence is obtained, or in warm room, can indicate that it is the twins.
If the ghost start a hunt dirrectly on top of a crucifix, it is the twins.
If differents speed are noticed between hunts (but speed remain constant during a single hunt), it can indicate that it is the twins.

ghosts.name: Raiju
weakness: Interfere with electronics from further away
power: More dangerous when near electronics
traits: During hunts and ghost events, the raiju will interfere with electronics from 15m instead of 10m.
If the raiju is closed to an active electronics (within 6/10m deppending of the map size), the hunt sanity threshold jumps from 50% to 65%.
During a hunt, if the raiju is close to any active electronic device, it will have a constant speed of 2.5m/s instead of the standard 1.7m/s.
strategies: If the ghost have massive acceleration when roaming during hunts, this might be a raiju. Be careful to test for the hantu too since they can have the same speed acceleration.

Since the electronic interference range is almost the same as the raiju audible range (20m), dropping a flashlight and checking the sound emitted by the ghost at the electronic interference range can help identifying a raiju. Be sure to check speed to not confuse it with a myling.

ghosts.name: Obake
power: Does not always leave fingerprints
Can reduce time left for fingerprints
traits: When interacting with an object that usually leaves fingerprints (door, salt, light switches), the obake has a 25% chances to not leave one.
When the obake leave a fingerprints, it has a ~17% chance to leave the wrong number of fingerprints (6 finger hand on doors or 2 fingerprints on light switches).
When it decide to trigger it's ability, it will reduce the remaining time of every fingerprints by half.

During a hunt, the obake will shapeshift into another ghost model (including his own) for one tick of the flickering. The obake will always shapeshift on the same ticks between each hunts, and the models will be in a predefined order.
strategies: If any fingerprint leaves the wrong number of finger, it is an obake.
If the ghost touch multiple surface (or walk in salt) and sometimes leaves fingerprints and sometimes not, it is an obake.

As a ghost footstep sound after it walked in salt can only be heard when it should leaves a footprint, it is possible to identify an obake because of a missing footstep sound even on a no evidence run.
During a hunt, it is possible to identify an obake with it's shapeshift abilty when looping the ghost.

ghosts.name: The Mimic
weakness: Will always show ghost orb along with all other evidences
power: Can mimic any ghost comportement except evidences
traits: The mimic will always provide the ghost orb evidences, no matter the number of evidences provided (so it usually has 4 evidences).

Every 30s to 2 minutes, the mimic will choose a ghost that it will copy until a new ghost is choosen. While copying a ghost, it act like that ghost in every point (ability, speed, hunt sanity threshold ...) except for it's evidences, and will always provide his own evidence.
The mimic can copy itself. If so, it will have standard hunt sanity threshold (50%) and standard speed (1.7m/s).
During the first minute of a contract, the mimic cannot copy another ghost, so if a ghost is identified during the first minute, checking for the mimic is not necessary
strategies: Always be sure to check for ghost orb when suspecting the mimic.
If a ghost is changing it's comportement very often (different speed, abilities, activity...) it's likely the mimic

ghosts.name: Moroi
power: Can curse a player, making it loose it's sanity faster
Speed depends on average sanity
traits: When a response is obtained through spirit box, or a paranormal sound is heard or recorded, the player at the source of the interaction will be cursed. Curses do not stack on a single player, but multiple player can be cursed.
When cursed, the passive sanity drain is doubled and it will always be active in the investigation area (light doesn't prevent it, but candles still reduce the drain).
Taking sanity pills will remove the curse. The player can still be cursed again after.
The moroi is faster, the lower the average sanity is. From 1.5m/s for sanity above 45%, and 2.25m/s below 5%.
When an icense is used during a hunt to escape the ghost, the moroi will be blinded for 7.5s instead of 5.
strategies: As the speed of the moroi is calculated in real time to the average sanity, it is likely to speed up a bit during a hunt while players have more than 5% average sanity and they are loosing sanity.

It is also possible to witness a significant change in the moroi speed by affecting greatly a player sanity (curse possessions to loose sanity, or pills to gain sanity). Make sure that the speed change is caused by the sanity change.
Smudging the moroi and counting the time blinded by the incense is also a way to identify the moroi. It is easier to do with tier 2 and 3 incenses as they slow down the ghost while it is blinded.

ghosts.name: Deogen
weakness: Very slow when close to a player
power: Always know where players are
Very fast when far from a player
traits: During hunts, the deogen is considered to always have line of sight with every player, so hiding in safe spot from it will not work and may result in death.

If the deogen's distance to the player targeted is below 2.5m, the ghost speed will be 0.4m/s making it the slowest ghost in the game. If the distance is over 6m, the ghost speed will be 3m/s. Between 2.5m and 6m, the speed increase or decrease lineary.
During hunts, the deogen will be slightly more visible than most of the other ghost (the invisible period of flickering will be shorter).
If a player ask a question through a spirit box, and the deogen is less than 1m close, then it have a 33% chance to produce a unique response instead.
As the ghost hunt mechanic is really unique, a contract ghost will never be a deogen before the host reaches level 30 of prestige 0 (the mimic can still imitate a deogen thought).
strategies: If a deogen is suspected, be careful to hide in places where you can easily escape.
As the deogen is the slowest ghost, the safest way to escape him during a hunt is to loop him around a table or in a room with a lot of space. It is also a good way to practice for looping a ghost.
The best way to identify a deogen is through a hunt, as it will always target a player and it's extrems speed will make it really easy to identify.

ghosts.name: Thaye
weakness: Age when close to player, making it slower and less aggressive
power: Very strong and dangerous at the start of the game
traits: The thaye have an internal age, starting at zero with maximum of 10. At age zero, the thaye have a speed of 2.75m/s, a hunt sanity threshold at 75% and a ghost event chance of 200%.
Every 1 to 2 minutes, the thaye will try to age. Every age gained will reduce it's base speed by 0.175m/s, the ghost event chance by 15%, and the hunt sanity threshold by 6%.
At age 10, the thaye have a speed of 1m/s, a ghost event chance of 50% and a hunt sanity threshold of 15%.
For every age gained, the thaye will gained from 1 to 4 "human age" (age provided by the ouija board).
strategies: If two differents ages are given by the ghost from the ouija board at different moment, the ghost is a thaye.
The other best way to identify a thaye is by it's hunting behavior, if speed changes are consistent through the contract, as the thaye will always slow down and never speed up.

ghosts.name: Aswang
power: Accelerate faster when chasing a player during a hunt
Will block the last hiding spot spotted
traits: The aswang cannot kill a player that is hinding in an official hiding spot. If a player is found by the ghost in one of these spot, the hunt will end instantly.

When a hunt is ended through it's ability, the spot will be marked by the aswang. Then, when a new hunt will begin, the aswang will instantly teleport to the marked spot, and will start to hunt from there
The aswang is slower than other ghost when roaming, but will build up speed 1.5 times faster than others when chasing a player.
strategies: If a hunt end at the moment a player is found in a hiding spot, the ghost is probably an aswang (be carefull of bad timing).
Any bad timing suspicion can be dispelled by checking if during the next hunt, the ghost appear in front of the hiding spot

ghosts.name: Dayan
power: Strong against moving players
traits: While the closest player within 10 meters of the dayan is moving, the dayan will have a hunt sanity threshold of 65% and will have a fixed speed of 2.3m/s.
While the closest player within 10 meters of the dayan is static, the dayan will have a hunt sanity threshold of 45% and will have a fixed speed of 1.2m/s.
If no players are within the 10 meters, the ghost will have the standard 50% hunt sanity threshold, and will follow the standard rule for speed during hunt.
The dayan can only be a female ghost, with a female name and ghost model.
strategies: The dayan can be ruled out if the ghost have a male name or a male ghost model.
The dayan can be identify with it's speed variation when a player is standing still or moving.

ghosts.name: Deildegast
weakness: Become slower when a player interact with an object
power: Very fast when no objetcs have been interacted with
traits: The deildegast does not follow the standard acceleration rules during hunt, and will always have a fixed speed.
The deildegast have a base speed of 3.0m/s.
Each time a player (dead or alive) interact with a unique object (outside of doors, cursed objects and equipment), it's speed decrease by 0.1m/s.
After a hunt, or a hunt atempt (blocked by crucifix), the speed of the deildegast will reset to 3.0m/s.
strategies: The ghost unique speed system and fixed speed with no line-of-sight acceleration is the best way to identify the deildegast.
The deildegast is the only entity with which the dead players can help the survivors, by picking up unique items and throwing them.
At 13 unique objects interacted, the ghost will have a speed equivalent to the standard ghost.

ghosts.name: Gallu
weakness: After being enraged, it is weakened
power: Stronger when enraged
Become enraged when protective equipements are used
Cannot step in salt when enraged
traits: The gallu have three different state : normal, enraged and weakened.
When enraged, the gallu's hunt sanity threshold is 60%, the crucifix range is reduced, the hunt speed is 1.96m/s and it cannot step in salt.
When normal, the gallu's hunt sanity threshold is 50% and the hunt speed is the standard 1.7m/s.
When weakened, the gallu's hunt sanity threshold is 40%, the crucifix range is increased and the hunt speed is 1.36m/s.
The gallu "increase" its state whenever an incense is used on it or when it step in salt (during or outside a hunt).
Whenever a hunt end and the gallu is in the enraged state, it will automatically switch to weakened (this is considered to be its ability).
strategies: If the ghost cannot walk in salt (during an event or hunt) it is likely a gallu. Be sure to not confuse it with a wraith, by either checking its speed, or checking that it still can walk in salt in other forms.
By smudging the gallu with an incense during a hunt and trigger its state change, the speed increase triggered by the state change can indicate that the entity is a Gallu.
If the ghost walk into a first pile of salt (or two if it began in weakened state), but is then unable to walk in other pile of salt, then it is a gallu.
